english.title: Make false / misleading statement to induce person to enter agreement / exercise rights conferred by investment
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[made a statement you knew to be false or misleading in a material respect,]_
(B)_[made a statement which was false or misleading in a material respect, being reckless as to whether it was,]_
(C)_[dishonestly concealed a material fact,]_
(D)_[dishonestly concealed material facts,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY THE STATEMENT / FACT..), with the intention of inducing, or being reckless as to whether

(E)_[making it]_
(F)_[concealing it]_
(G)_[concealing them]_

may have induced, another person to

(H)_[enter into or offer to enter into, or to refrain from entering or offering to enter into, a relevant agreement]_
(I)_[exercise, or refrain from exercising, rights conferred by a relevant investment]_
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 89 and 92 of the Financial Services Act 2012.
english.pointstoprove:

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Investment includes any asset, right or interest.
(ii) Relevant agreement means an agreement -
(a) the entering into or performance of which by either party constitutes an activity of a kind specified in an order made by the Treasury, and (b) which relates to a relevant investment.
(iii) Relevant benchmark means a benchmark of a kind specified in an order made by the Treasury.
(iv) Relevant investment means an investment of a kind specified in an order made by the Treasury.
(v) SI 2021/1173 amended the penalty for this offence with effect from 1st November 2021. For an offence that is committed before that date use this offence wording. For an offence that is committed on or after that date, see H23086.
(vi) Where an offence is found to be committed over a period of two or more days, or at some point during a period of two or more days, it is to be taken to have been committed on the first of those days, see section 31(4) of the Financial Services Act 2021.

other.penalty:
Summary: Twelve months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: Seven years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Note: The reference to 'Twelve months imprisonment' should be read as a reference to 'Six months imprisonment' until the commencement of section 154(1) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003. On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.

Time limit for prosecution:
None
